call_points.text: Management expects repo rate hike to add 7 to 9 bps to NIM in Q3, with repo-linked loan book repricing immediately.
Loan book ECL transition impact now estimated at ₹8,000 Cr, down from earlier expectations.
Corporate sanctions crossed ₹2.5 lakh Cr in H1FY27.
Ongoing credit cost guided at 0.25% to 0.30%, including estimated steady-state ECL provision requirement.
Bank reduced CD outstanding from ₹60,000 Cr to ₹40,000 Cr.
Gold loan book grew to ₹36,000 Cr from ₹18,300 Cr in Sep-25.
Bank targets total recoveries between ₹12,000 Cr and ₹13,000 Cr.
Global NIM is expected to remain in the range of 2.6% to 2.7% for FY27.

operating_notes.text: Disputed Income Tax demands not provided for stood at ₹10,647.16 Cr as of March 31, 2026.
Govt securities face value of ₹99,854.25 Cr kept as margin with RBI/CCIL/clearing houses as of March 31, 2026.

RBI imposed four penalties on PNB — ₹2,91,750, ₹1,33,800, ₹1,34,600 and ₹2,99,600 — for non-compliance with currency chest operational guidelines, received 9 and 11 Sep 2026 and paid by direct debit from the bank's RBI account.
Transferred outstanding Investment Fluctuation Reserve (IFR) balance of ₹4,143.55 Cr to Other Reserves (General Reserve) following RBI directions.
FY27 annual guidance targets total recoveries > ₹13,000 Cr and credit cost below 0.4%.
Loans disbursed since July 1, 2020 represent 71.60% of total book, with NPA of only 0.42% under fresh underwriting.
Out of ₹5,42,900 Cr total saving deposits, individual SA is ₹4,82,700 Cr (+8.5% YoY) while institutional SA de-grew 3.84% to ₹60,100 Cr.
